newsitem.title: INDIA: Fair demand at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Fair demand at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: There was fair demand for all categories of teas at this week's Calcutta auction, traders said.
In all 97,584 packages, including 9,941 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
CTC varieties all eased by 1.50 to two rupees while browner fibrous sorts declined further, traders said.
Among orthodox teas, clean larger brokens were around last levels. Smaller brokens and plainer fannings were easier by one to two rupees.
In the dust variety all sorts eased by one to two rupees.
